buildCommand: if [ -d scripts ]; then node scripts/build-vercel-output.cjs; else node ../scripts/build-vercel-output.cjs; fi
installCommand: if [ -d frontend ] && [ -d backend ]; then npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm install --prefix backend --include=dev; elif [ -d ../frontend ] && [ -d ../backend ]; then npm install --prefix ../frontend --include=dev && npm install --prefix ../backend --include=dev; else npm install --include=dev; fi
